name: Proto-urban Site of Sarazm
description: Sarazm, whose name means "where the land begins," is a 5,000-year-old settlement site near Panjakent in northwestern Tajikistan, beside the Zeravshan River. Its ruins show one of Central Asia's earliest towns, placed between mountain pastures for herders and a fertile valley for farmers. Finds here reveal trade links stretching to the Iranian plateau, the Indus valley and the Indian Ocean.
